What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Hi, once an order has already shipped, it can no longer be changed.

That includes updates like adding items, removing items, changing the shipping address, or canceling the order. If you need to cancel after shipment, return shipping costs would apply.

If you want help with a specific order, our team can be reached at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.

If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?

If your order is canceled and a refund is issued, it will be processed back to your original method of payment.

It typically takes about 3 to 5 business days for the refund to show on your account, depending on your bank or card provider.

If you ever receive a refund as store credit instead of back to your card, that credit is available in your account right away.
